description: Keep your household's Grocy up to date from anywhere: book purchases, use and move stock, look up barcodes, send the shopping list, put what's running low on it, and tick off chores, tasks and battery changes. Start a workflow when food is about to go off or runs low, or a chore, task or battery is due.

output.name: The battery's name

output.next_charge_due: When it's next due a charge, blank when not set

parameters.description: How many days before it's due to run: 0 for on the day. Leave blank for 0.
